bites.title: Take the picture
bites.body: Rendering turns your scene into a finished image, seen through the camera.

bites.title: Pick an engine
bites.body: Properties, the camera-back tab (Render). Change Render Engine to something else, then back if you like. EEVEE is fast, Cycles is physically accurate, Workbench is a quick preview.

bites.title: Smaller for speed
bites.body: Open the printer tab (Output). Set the % under Resolution to 50. Half size renders four times faster while you experiment.
bites.hint: Output tab, Format, Resolution, the % field.

bites.title: F12
bites.body: Hover the viewport and press F12. A render window opens and your picture appears.
bites.hint: No F12? Render menu at the top, Render Image.

bites.title: Keep it
bites.body: In the render window, use Image, Save As to keep your picture. Then close the render window to come back here.

bites.title: Lesson 12: cleared
bites.body:
Engines, resolution, F12, and saving the image. You can make pictures now.

Reward: the Timeline is about to slide in. Scroll on for Lesson 13: time.
